questions.question: What is the primary role of the pipe operator (`|`) in LangChain Expression Language (LCEL)?
options: A) It performs bitwise OR operations on model outputs.
B) It chains Runnable objects together by passing the output of one component as the input to the next.
C) It executes two chains in parallel.
D) It opens a database pipe for stream processing.
questions.explanation: In LCEL, `|` composes Runnables (e.g. `prompt | model | parser`) into a seamless single execution pipeline.

questions.question: How does `RunnableWithMessageHistory` manage chat state across turns?
options: A) It rewrites the model's weights after every message.
B) It wraps a chain and automatically loads/saves chat messages from a factory function using a session_id.
C) It requires you to pass the full history string manually inside every prompt invocation.
D) It saves all conversations to an external API endpoint.
questions.explanation: `RunnableWithMessageHistory` wraps an underlying Runnable and manages session-based memory using a chat history factory keyed on session_id.
